item.title: United Brings Polaris® Lounge Access to Domestic Flights With New Coastliner Aircraft - The Bulkhead Seat
item.description: United Airlines is introducing a major shift in its premium domestic travel experience, bringing its long-haul United Polaris® (Business Class) and lounge access to select transcontinental routes for the first time. At the center of this move is a new subfleet of Airbus A321neo aircraft, branded as "Coastliner," which will begin flying later this summer between key hubs.

item.title: United's New Embraer CRJ450 Will Ditch Overhead Bins in First Class - The Bulkhead Seat
item.description: In addition to the new "Coastliner" Airbus A321neo aircraft that United will bring on soon for transcontinental flights, the carrier is also elevating the regional jet experience. United will begin flying the Embraer CRJ450 with just 41 seats (including seven in First Class). Premium passengers will see a big change in how their luggage is stored as overhead bins will not be present on the plane and luggage will instead be stored in lockers up front.
